<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>general</nowiki></strong><nowiki> natural combat style progression template for new players to follow devised by the RuneScape Discord Luminaries in collaboration with PVME. From levels 1 - 50, where an item is marked P2P, this means it is a members item.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 13 April 2024</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlimited supply of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1" alt="airrune" title="airrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1" alt="waterrune" title="waterrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1" alt="earthrune" title="earthrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1" alt="firerune" title="firerune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the element the player chooses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 10 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Imp horn wand, Imphide book</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 20 ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Spider wand, Spider orb</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>

<nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This armour is free and can be obtained from </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Gudrik <nowiki>Gudrik</nowiki>]<nowiki> in Port Sarim.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amulet of Magic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Spellstorm_drape <nowiki>Spellstorm drape</nowiki>]<nowiki> - Best in Slot cape for F2P</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Silverhawk_boots <nowiki>Silverhawk boots</nowiki>]<nowiki> (</nowiki><em><nowiki>non-ironman &amp; P2P</nowiki></em><nowiki>) can be freely claimed from the Marketplace and give a small damage boost.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The boots can be upgraded at lvl 20, 40, 50 and 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> respectively.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="gear_2"><nowiki>Gear:</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 60 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Guthix_staff <nowiki>Guthix staff</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Grifolic wand &amp; Grifolic orb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 70 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_staff <nowiki>Crystal staff</nowiki>]<nowiki> or </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_wand <nowiki>Crystal wand</nowiki>]<nowiki> &amp; </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_orb <nowiki>Crystal orb</nowiki>]</p>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Armour</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 65 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Superior_skeletal_armour <nowiki>Superior Skeletal armour</nowiki>]<nowiki> - made using Skeletal armour and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_equipment_patch <nowiki>Fremennik equipment patches</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Whilst Superior Skeletal armour degrades, degradation takes a very long time - don't let this put you off!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 70 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Subjugation robe armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This an expensive but worthwhile upgrade - it is okay to use Superior Skeletal armour until this becomes affordable</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Salve amulet(e)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if fighting undead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ One of the God books </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404682.png?v=1" alt="zarosbook" title="zarosbook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439356809216.png?v=1" alt="guthixbook" title="guthixbook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439461404672.png?v=1" alt="zambook" title="zambook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159051915264.png?v=1" alt="armabook" title="armabook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439473987628.png?v=1" alt="bandosbook" title="bandosbook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574290439482638346.png?v=1" alt="sarabook" title="sarabook" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="frequently-asked-questions"><ins><nowiki>Frequently asked questions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ At level 37 I unlock Detonate but it's not used on the bars. Why?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Detonate is an Area-of-effect ability that doesn't work well with revolution - you will have to activate this manually as it requires charging. Revolution will override the charge and &quot;waste&quot; the ability.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ What are Special Attacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and how do I use them?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Certain weapons e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> have special attacks - these are powerful abilities that you have to activate manually. Therefore, place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> outside your revolution bar (the abilities with gold trim around them) if your weapon has one. You can find the ability in your Constitution </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> abilities.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ How do I select a spell?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To select a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> combat spell:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Spellbook → right click chosen spell → select auto cast → select option 3 (main hand &amp; off-hand).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ When should I change spells?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You should regularly upgrade your auto-cast to the highest available spell tier. You can find out a spell's damage level cap by checking its tooltip.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>For example: Air strike's damage cap is at level 16 - you can upgrade to Air bolt at level 17.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Can I just train slayer?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You certainly can if you want some variety. It is, however, slower to train at lower combat levels.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>⬥ Why are weapons upgrades more important than armour upgrades? / Why is power armour recommended over tank armour?</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Frankly put: You gain more from hitting harder than from getting hit less. A higher tier weapon lets you hit harder by increasing hit chance and damage bonus. Power armour increases damage bonus too. This lets you hit harder and kill more monsters, which means more xp gained per hour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>
